title: Equipment instances of one site
description: The plant tree of sites/<site>/instances/*.instance.json. One entry per node; partOf builds the equipment path, equipmentLevel follows the ISA-88 / ISA-95 role-based equipment hierarchy (Enterprise > Site > Area > ProcessCell > Unit > EquipmentModule > ControlModule; B2MML EquipmentLevel). A class is a released profile of standard/profiles; plain hierarchy nodes carry none. Owner decision 24.09.; structure after the customer reference-concept instances.

_note.description: One sentence. Reasoning belongs in the site README.

id.description: Unique within the site; sources bind to it by instanceRef.

code.description: The segment of this node in the UNS path; defaults to id.

class.description: The equipment class (profileId); absent on plain hierarchy nodes.

partOf.description: id of the parent node; null only on the Enterprise.
